brief: A shared trip planner: friends plan the itinerary, bookings, places and lists together, and every change shows up for everyone live. Japan first, more countries later. It should feel shared and warm, but also premium and minimal.
criteria: Success: avoids travel clichés (pins, planes, globes), doesn't depend on Japan, recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour, keeps the app's red.

concepts.name: Step up
concepts.idea: The two o's of toogo walk side by side, and the second one steps up: two people going together, one already on the next step.
rationale: Comes straight from the name: the 'too' (two) in toogo, with no travel cliché
Warm and friendly, yet only two circles: premium and minimal
Doesn't depend on Japan, so it stays right when new countries arrive
Built on one stroke width; a heavier cut keeps it clear at 16 px

recommendation: Step up: red on white across the product, with a red app-icon tile so it stands out on the home screen.
next_steps: Swap the new icons into the app
Update the app name and manifest
